LEMMA L-half: 2h = X -> X*Z = 2*(h*Z)
LEMMA L-dist: a*(b+c) = a*b + a*c, (b+c)*a = b*a + c*a, the same with -
LEMMA L-one: a >= 1, b >= 1 -> a*b >= 1
